newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TVK rally boosts Budapest bourse.
newsitem.headline: TVK rally boosts Budapest bourse.

text.p: Most Hungarian shares were little changed on Friday, but the continued rally of TVK and Pick and the gains of Richter pushed the BUX index above 3,700 points, traders said.
The BUX closed at 3,700.99 points, up 26.38.
"There were some papers which pulled the index," said Zsolt Katona of ING Barings. "For example TVK, which rose by more than five percent and Richter more than 1.5 percent."

Chemicals maker TVK rose in the past few days on news that a 10.5 percent stake had been sold outside the Budapest stock Exchange and those shares were no longer expected to flood the bourse, dealers said.
One dealer added that speculation also moved the price upward, with one player buying a large number of TVK shares in the past few days.
Dealers said pharmaceuticals company Richter's price was corrected upwards on Friday. The share ended at 8,680, up 135.
The meat processor Pick, which had reported good third quarter results, also extended its gains.
The price rose as a large buyer bought many Pick shares recently, while the selling side was weak, a dealer said.
Dealers said December was likely to bring slight upward and downward movements in the BSE's BUX index, but they did not see the market change much next month.
